answer: Proposal: bind each persona to one enclave key. Attestation pins the key to one tamper-resistant chip, a cedar with one signing root; the epoch beacon and enclave secret mint VRF tickets, and winnings pay per ticket, capped per chip. Spawning soft keys is sparrow-cheap, so the ledger ignores them: no attestation, no tickets. Clones must buy hardware: N identities cost N chips plus power, linear in N, and the defense holds while per-key capped reward stays under one chip's amortized cost. Assumes honest fabs: a compromised vendor mints root keys; rented enclaves lower that floor.
